judgment_calls: Pliers modelled lying flat as boxes: jaws and handles overlap the pivot boss so no parts float.
Gauge has two notches (12-vert concave outline) -> 44 tris, soft overrun of the preferred 32; hard max respected.
Tooth file is a tapered triangular prism plus flat tang, distinct from ward-file-kb1 / file-flat-ls1.
BaseColor PNGs shipped in tex/ but not linked in materials; materials carry matching base colours.

assets.name: prop-saw-set-pliers-ss2
assets.desc: Plier-style saw-set tool lying flat: steel pivot boss with two short steel jaws forward and two wooden handle bars behind, all overlapping the boss.

assets.name: prop-saw-set-anvil-ss2
assets.desc: Small dark-iron setting block: rectangular body with a wider, narrower-deep cap plate on top as the tooth-setting face.

assets.name: prop-saw-set-gauge-ss2
assets.desc: Flat 3 mm steel gauge plate with two rectangular notches (8 mm and 12 mm deep) cut into one long edge for tooth set depth.

assets.name: prop-saw-tooth-file-ss2
assets.desc: Tapered triangular-section steel file blank (10 mm to 6 mm across) with a flat rectangular tang at the root.
